<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" dir="ltr">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#f6f3ed" />
  <meta name="description" content="Femi Art — handmade crochet, home decor, bespoke gifts and textile pieces lovingly crafted in Egypt. Touch of Love." />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Femi Art — Touch of Love" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="Thoughtfully handmade pieces for the home, little ones and everyday moments." />
  <meta property="og:image" content="" />
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64," type="image/svg+xml" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;500;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Italiana&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
:root{--ink:#20352b;--deep:#20372c;--earth:#ae9479;--paper:#f6f3ed;--cream:#fffcf7;--sand:#e8e0d3;--line:#ded8cd;--soft:#758478;--font-display:'Italiana','Times New Roman',serif;--font-body:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;--font-ar:'Cairo',Tahoma,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:14px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body.locked{overflow:hidden}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
button,select,input,textarea{outline-offset:4px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #6a866a!important}
::selection{background:#b7c8a7;color:#20352b}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.shell{width:min(100% - 100px,1470px);margin-inline:auto}
.skip-link{position:fixed;z-index:300;background:white;top:-70px;left:12px;padding:12px 20px}.skip-link:focus{top:10px}
.progress{position:fixed;z-index:120;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:var(--progress,0%);background:#c29468;pointer-events:none}
.announcement{height:31px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:18px;background:var(--deep);color:#e8e9de;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2.1px;text-align:center}.tiny-sparkle{font-size:12px;color:#d8c0a3}
.site-header{z-index:80;position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(246,243,237,.95);border-bottom:1px solid #e8e1d4;backdrop-filter:blur(22px)}
.header-inner{height:92px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:24px}.desktop-nav,.nav-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:31px}.desktop-nav a,.footer-right a{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:color .3s}.desktop-nav a:hover,.footer-right a:hover{color:#9b775e}.nav-actions{justify-content:flex-end;gap:22px}.brand{text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;line-height:1;position:relative;min-width:180px}.brand-icon{position:absolute;font-size:15px;left:-1px;top:-6px;color:#b69c80}.brand-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:40px;letter-spacing:-1.2px}.brand-dot,.footer-brand span{color:#bb977c}.brand-caption{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:3px;font-weight:600;margin-top:5px}.text-button{border:0;background:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.lang-switch{min-width:38px}.icon-button{width:37px;height:37px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--ink);position:relative}.icon-button svg,.search-input-wrap svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round}.icon-button:hover{opacity:.63}.cart-count{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;background:var(--deep);color:white;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:9px}.menu-toggle{display:none}.mobile-menu{padding:8px 24px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.mobile-menu a{display:block;padding:13px 3px;font-size:17px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.4px;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 33px}.dash{height:1px;width:28px;background:currentColor;display:inline-block}.section-space{padding-block:145px}.section-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(56px,6vw,106px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-3.1px;margin:0}.section-title em,.hero h1 em,.editorial h2 em,.custom-inner h2 em,.contact h2 em{font-style:normal;color:#a3876f}.section-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px;margin-bottom:51px}.section-intro{width:min(310px,100%);color:#6a756c;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;margin:0 2px 6px 0}
.hero{min-height:750px;position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:45% 55%;padding-top:55px;padding-bottom:78px}.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;align-self:center;padding-bottom:25px}.hero-copy .eyebrow{margin-bottom:37px}.hero h1{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(68px,7.6vw,126px);letter-spacing:-4.8px;line-height:.98;margin:0 0 36px;white-space:nowrap}.hero-description{font-size:16px;line-height:1.95;max-width:415px;color:#6a756c;margin:0 0 33px}.hero-buttons{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}.button{border:1px solid transparent;min-height:51px;padding:14px 22px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:27px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1px;transition:background .28s,color .28s,border .28s,transform .28s;white-space:nowrap}.button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}.button-dark{background:var(--deep);color:#fff}.button-dark:hover{background:#425f4c}.button-light{background:var(--cream);color:var(--deep)}.button-light:hover{background:#d8dfd0}.button-outline{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink);background:transparent}.button-outline:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}.text-link{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;background:transparent;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:5px 0 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.text-link:hover{color:#a3876f}.hero-counter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:17px;margin-top:94px;color:#829084;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.hero-counter-number{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:1px}.hero-counter-number span{color:#adb3a8}.hero-counter-rule{width:60px;height:1px;background:#c9cfc7}.hero-visual{position:relative;min-height:655px;padding-inline:64px 38px}.arch-image{height:100%;min-height:655px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:290px 290px 3px 3px;background:#ded5c4}.arch-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 46%;transition:transform 1.5s var(--ease)}.arch-image:hover img{transform:scale(1.045)}.image-stamp{position:absolute;top:4%;right:3%;width:130px;height:130px;border:1px solid #e6e5dc;color:#f7f5ed;background:rgba(36,58,47,.78);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;transform:rotate(-16deg)}.stamp-ring{position:absolute;max-width:92px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:3.5;font-size:8px}.stamp-flower{font-size:38px;color:#fff}.hero-side-label{position:absolute;top:35%;right:-30px;transform:rotate(90deg);transform-origin:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#7a887b;white-space:nowrap}.floating-photo{width:194px;position:absolute;left:-31px;bottom:20px;background:white;padding:9px 9px 13px;box-shadow:0 20px 55px #1a271f2c;transform:rotate(-6deg);transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}.floating-photo:hover{transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-8px)}.floating-photo img{width:100%;height:180px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center}.floating-photo>span{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.3px;padding-top:12px}.hero-down{position:absolute;bottom:29px;left:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;font-weight:700;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#7c897c}.down-arrow{font-size:22px;font-weight:300}
.marquee-outer{overflow:hidden;border-block:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px 0;background:#ebe5da}.marquee-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:marquee 28s linear infinite}.marquee-track span{white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,47px);letter-spacing:3px;padding-right:55px}.marquee-track i{color:#a78e76;font-style:normal;padding:0 32px;font-size:24px}@keyframes marquee{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.18fr 1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:310px 280px;gap:18px}.category-card{border:0;padding:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;color:white;background:#d8cbb9}.category-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 40%,rgba(17,32,25,.67) 100%);transition:background .3s}.category-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1s var(--ease)}.category-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.07)}.category-tall{grid-row:span 2}.category-medium{grid-column:span 1}.category-small{grid-column:span 1}.category-card:nth-child(2) img{object-position:center 44%}.category-card:nth-child(3) img{object-position:center 45%}.category-card:nth-child(4) img{object-position:center 42%}.category-overlay{position:absolute;z-index:1;bottom:27px;left:25px;right:25px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:end;gap:9px}.category-index{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700}.category-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(26px,2.5vw,41px);line-height:1.13}.category-arrow{font-size:25px;font-weight:300;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s}.category-card:hover .category-arrow{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}
.story-strip{background:#e6dfd3;padding:45px 0}.story-strip-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:20px}.story-strip-inner>span{font-size:35px;color:#bda387}.story-strip p{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(29px,3.5vw,52px);margin:0;text-align:center}.story-strip p em{font-style:normal;color:#aa886c}
.shop-controls{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:32px}.filter-list{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:none}.filter-list::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.filter-pill{border:1px solid #d2d1c5;background:transparent;padding:11px 17px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#728074;transition:all .25s}.filter-pill:hover,.filter-pill.active{background:var(--deep);border-color:var(--deep);color:#fff}.shop-sort{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}.shop-sort select{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink);padding:8px;max-width:120px;color:var(--ink)}.product-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:48px 20px}.product-card{min-width:0}.product-photo{display:block;position:relative;background:#e9e3d8;aspect-ratio:4/5;overflow:hidden;border:0;width:100%;padding:0}.product-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}.product-photo:hover img{transform:scale(1.07)}.product-photo::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.12),transparent 30%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}.product-photo:hover::after{opacity:1}.product-tag{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:#faf7efeb;padding:7px 11px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase}.quick-view{position:absolute;bottom:13px;left:13px;right:13px;text-align:center;padding:13px;background:#fffdf5f5;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;transform:translateY(calc(100% + 20px));transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}.product-photo:hover .quick-view,.product-photo:focus-visible .quick-view{transform:translateY(0)}.product-details{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:10px;padding-top:17px}.product-type{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#889287;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 8px}.product-name{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;margin:0}.product-pricing{font-size:11px;color:#899488;display:block;margin-top:5px}.product-add{height:38px;width:38px;flex-shrink:0;background:transparent;border:1px solid #ccd0c6;border-radius:50%;font-size:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:all .25s}.product-add:hover{background:var(--deep);color:white}.center-action{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:62px}.empty-products{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:70px 20px;color:#79857a}
.editorial{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:790px;background:var(--deep);color:#f9f5ec}.editorial-image{position:relative;overflow:hidden}.editorial-image>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 50%}.image-note{position:absolute;bottom:30px;left:30px;color:white;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px}.editorial-content{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:80px clamp(45px,7vw,135px);overflow:hidden}.light-eyebrow{color:#c1cdbc}.editorial h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(58px,5.3vw,90px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-2px;line-height:1.06;margin:0 0 32px;position:relative;z-index:1}.editorial h2 em{color:#c5a487}.editorial-content>p:not(.eyebrow){max-width:440px;font-size:15px;line-height:2;color:#bfcabd;z-index:1;margin:0 0 34px}.outline-flower{position:absolute;font-size:420px;color:#aec1b0;opacity:.055;top:2%;right:-15%;line-height:1;pointer-events:none}.editorial .button{position:relative;z-index:1}
.values{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;padding-block:78px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.value{padding-right:25px}.value+.value{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:40px}.value-icon{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:36px;color:#a58e77}.value h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:34px;margin:8px 0 10px}.value p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;color:#7b867c;max-width:290px}
.lookbook-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .88fr .82fr;gap:18px;align-items:start}.lookbook-image{overflow:hidden;background:#dfd4c6}.lookbook-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s}.lookbook-image:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}.lookbook-one{height:630px;grid-row:span 2}.lookbook-two{height:440px;margin-top:68px}.lookbook-three{height:530px}.lookbook-caption{grid-column:2/4;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,37px);line-height:1.3;color:#8c816f;margin:0;max-width:480px}
.custom-banner{background:#e9e1d4;overflow:hidden}.custom-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.4fr 1.08fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:35px;min-height:585px}.custom-symbol{font-size:165px;align-self:start;padding-top:52px;color:#c2b29d}.custom-inner>div{padding-block:60px}.custom-inner .eyebrow{margin-bottom:28px}.custom-inner h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(48px,4.3vw,78px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-1.7px;line-height:1.07;margin:0 0 24px}.custom-inner p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:14px;max-width:450px;line-height:2;color:#69796d;margin:0 0 30px}.custom-inner>img{height:500px;width:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:250px 250px 0 0;align-self:end;margin-top:40px}
.contact .eyebrow{margin-bottom:45px}.contact-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .6fr;gap:50px;align-items:end}.contact h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(56px,6.5vw,107px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-3px;margin:0}.contact-side p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.95;color:#738074;margin:0 0 28px}.contact-link{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:20px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px}.contact-link:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.contact-link span{font-size:22px;font-weight:400}.contact-link:hover{color:#a68d76}
.site-footer{background:#eae5dc}.footer-top{padding:75px 0 58px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;border-bottom:1px solid #d1cdc2}.footer-brand{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(55px,8vw,124px);line-height:1}.footer-brand small{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:11px;display:block;letter-spacing:5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:10px}.footer-right{display:flex;gap:28px}.footer-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:25px;padding:20px 0 29px;color:#879184;font-size:10px}
.screen-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,35,26,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:150;animation:fadeIn .2s}.drawer{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:min(520px,100%);background:var(--cream);z-index:160;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateX(105%);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}.drawer.active{transform:translateX(0)}.drawer-head{padding:32px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.drawer-head .eyebrow{margin:0 0 8px}.drawer-head h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:35px;margin:0;font-weight:400}.close-button{font-size:31px;font-weight:300}.drawer-body{padding:30px 32px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1}.drawer-foot{padding:22px 32px 30px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.cart-note{color:#899385;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}.full-width{width:100%}.cart-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px 1fr auto;gap:18px;padding:0 0 23px;margin-bottom:23px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.cart-item img{width:88px;height:104px;object-fit:cover}.cart-item h3{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 9px}.cart-item p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#899187;margin:0 0 6px}.cart-item .remove-item{border:0;background:none;color:#b07a6f;font-size:20px;align-self:start}.cart-item-qty{font-weight:700;color:#5c6d60;font-size:11px}.cart-empty{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}.cart-empty span{font-size:65px;color:#aa9b87}.cart-empty h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:36px;margin:8px}.cart-empty p{color:#828f83;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;max-width:220px}
.search-modal,.inquiry-modal,.product-modal{z-index:160;position:fixed;background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 25px 90px #15241b44;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-45%) scale(.97);transition:opacity .25s,transform .36s var(--ease);max-height:min(90vh,1000px);overflow:auto}.search-modal.active,.inquiry-modal.active,.product-modal.active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}.search-modal{left:50%;top:31%;width:min(800px,calc(100% - 36px));padding:35px 40px}.search-top,.inquiry-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.search-top h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:43px;font-weight:400;margin:0}.search-input-wrap{margin-top:25px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #b4beb1;padding:10px 0}.search-input-wrap input{width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;font-size:19px;padding:10px;outline:none}.search-input-wrap svg{flex-shrink:0}.search-help{font-size:12px;color:#8b968b}.search-results{display:grid;gap:10px;max-height:360px;overflow:auto;margin-top:25px}.search-result{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;text-align:left;border:0;background:#f3eee6;padding:7px;color:var(--ink)}.search-result img{width:55px;height:66px;object-fit:cover}.search-result span{flex:1;font-size:14px}.search-result small{font-size:11px;color:#8a968b}
.product-modal{width:min(1020px,calc(100% - 42px));left:50%;top:50%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;overflow:visible}.modal-close{z-index:4;position:absolute;right:11px;top:11px;width:38px;height:38px;background:#fff8}.modal-photo{height:min(84vh,800px);overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#ddd5c7}.modal-photo>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.modal-thumbs{position:absolute;bottom:15px;left:15px;display:flex;gap:8px}.modal-thumbs button{border:2px solid #fff;background:white;padding:0;opacity:.7}.modal-thumbs button.active{opacity:1;border-color:#789176}.modal-thumbs img{width:48px;height:58px;object-fit:cover}.modal-content{height:min(84vh,800px);overflow-y:auto;padding:65px 44px 35px}.modal-content .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px;color:#9c8a75}.modal-content h2{font-size:clamp(38px,3vw,56px);font-weight:400;font-family:var(--font-display);line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 20px}.modal-content>p:not(.eyebrow){color:#7e8a7f;font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;margin-bottom:19px}.form-rule{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:25px 0}.form-label{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;margin:16px 0 7px}.field{width:100%;border:1px solid #dcded2;background:transparent;padding:13px 15px;min-height:45px;border-radius:0;color:var(--ink);resize:vertical;font-size:13px}.field:focus{border-color:#64806d}.modal-actions{display:flex;gap:15px;margin-top:24px;align-items:center}.modal-actions .button{flex:1;min-width:0}.quantity{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);height:52px;align-items:center}.quantity button{width:33px;font-size:19px;border:0;background:transparent}.quantity span{min-width:15px;text-align:center}.modal-content .product-disclaimer{font-size:10px!important;color:#8c958a!important;margin-top:15px!important}

.js .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(38px);transition:opacity .9s var(--ease),transform .9s var(--ease)}.js .reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* V3 · Orbit / text choreography. Keep the original font stacks unchanged. */
.orbit-gallery{position:relative;height:315vh;min-height:1800px;background:#23382e;color:#f7f2e8;isolation:isolate}
.orbit-stage{position:sticky;top:0;height:100svh;min-height:620px;overflow:hidden;perspective:1800px}
.orbit-decor{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 54% 66% at 50% 54%,#5a715c4f,transparent 68%),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 12%,#d1bda41c,transparent 40%);z-index:0}
.orbit-decor:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:26px;border:1px solid #ffffff14;pointer-events:none}
.orbit-intro{position:absolute;left:50%;top:46%;transform:translateY(0);translate:-50% -50%;width:min(610px,68vw);z-index:50;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform,opacity}
.orbit-intro .eyebrow{justify-content:center;color:#d7c3a4;margin-bottom:20px;font-size:10px}
.orbit-intro h2,.orbit-finale h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(58px,5.5vw,96px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:0;color:#fff9ed}
.orbit-intro h2 em,.orbit-finale h2 em{font-style:normal;color:#d5b792}
.orbit-intro>p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;color:#d2d8ce;margin:25px auto 0;max-width:380px}
.orbit-instruction{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:30px;color:#dbcab5;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;font-weight:700}
.orbit-scroll-icon{border:1px solid #d5bea490;border-radius:50%;width:26px;height:26px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px}
.orbit-finale{position:absolute;top:108px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;width:90%;z-index:55;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.orbit-finale .eyebrow{justify-content:center;color:#dbc3a4;margin:0 0 8px;font-size:9px}
.orbit-finale h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,48px);line-height:1.05}
.orbit-deck{position:absolute;inset:0;perspective:1350px;transform-style:flat;z-index:12;cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none}
.orbit-deck:active{cursor:grabbing}
.orbit-card{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:clamp(145px,15.5vw,207px);height:clamp(190px,25.5vw,260px);padding:7px 7px 0;border:1px solid #e8dfce70;border-radius:4px;background:#f5efe3;color:#24372c;box-shadow:0 20px 48px #0d1f1792;transform-origin:center center;transform-style:preserve-3d;backface-visibility:hidden;will-change:transform,opacity;overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s;text-align:left}
.orbit-card:hover{box-shadow:0 26px 62px #09190ebf;border-color:#f8e7c4}
.orbit-card img{width:100%;height:calc(100% - 38px);object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none}
.orbit-card-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-content:space-between;height:38px;padding:0 5px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1px;white-space:nowrap}
.orbit-card-caption>span:nth-child(2){overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.orbit-card-caption>span:first-child{font-size:9px;opacity:.55}
.orbit-card-caption>span:last-child{font-size:17px}
.orbit-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e6c99b!important;outline-offset:5px}
.orbit-footer{position:absolute;bottom:27px;left:50%;translate:-50% 0;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:23px;pointer-events:none;color:#dfd7c9;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px}
.orbit-progress{height:1px;background:#ffffff45;flex:1;min-width:60px}
.orbit-progress>span{display:block;width:100%;height:2px;background:#d5b792;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left center}
#orbitPercent{min-width:40px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.orbit-mobile-controls{display:none}
/* An oversized typographic bridge. Large text moves in opposing scroll directions. */
.kinetic-section{padding:95px 0 102px;overflow:hidden;background:#e9e1d4;color:#26392c;position:relative}
.kinetic-kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:47px}
.kinetic-kicker .eyebrow{margin:0}
.kinetic-kicker>span:last-child{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.6px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.kinetic-lanes{display:grid;gap:0;direction:ltr;width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:visible}
.kinetic-line{will-change:transform;transition:transform .06s linear;text-align:center}
.kinetic-line span{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;display:inline-block;font-size:clamp(62px,9.7vw,159px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-4px}
.kinetic-line-2 span{color:#9a8068;font-style:italic}
.kinetic-line-3 span{color:#526d56}
.kinetic-note{margin-top:45px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.9px;text-align:center;color:#6c786a}
/* Cinematic text masks — the font faces remain exactly those of V1/V2. */
.type-mask{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.10em;margin-bottom:-.10em}
.type-line{display:block;transform-origin:0 100%}
.js .type-motion .type-line{transform:translate3d(0,116%,0) rotate(2deg);opacity:.1;filter:blur(6px);transition:transform 1.04s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity 1.04s,filter 1.04s;transition-delay:var(--line-delay,0ms)}
.js .type-motion.type-visible .type-line{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;filter:blur(0)}
/* RTL leaves the same Arabic typography family untouched. */
html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-intro h2,html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-finale h2,html[dir="rtl"] .kinetic-line span{font-family:var(--font-ar);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-1px}
html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-intro h2{font-size:clamp(48px,5.1vw,78px);line-height:1.34}
html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-finale h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,45px);line-height:1.30}
html[dir="rtl"] .kinetic-line span{font-size:clamp(42px,8vw,120px);line-height:1.32}
html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-card-caption{direction:rtl}
html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-footer{direction:rtl}
html[dir="rtl"] .orbit-progress>span{transform-origin:right center}
@media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:861px){.orbit-intro h2{font-size:clamp(53px,5.5vw,68px)}.orbit-card{width:165px;height:220px}}
@media(max-width:860px){
 .orbit-gallery{height:auto;min-height:0;padding:73px 0 30px}
 .orbit-stage{position:relative;min-height:0;height:auto;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;perspective:1000px}
 .orbit-intro{position:relative;left:auto;top:auto;translate:none;transform:none!important;opacity:1!important;width:min(100% - 40px,550px);margin:0 auto;order:0;z-index:10}
 .orbit-intro .eyebrow{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:17px}
 .orbit-intro h2{font-size:clamp(55px,9.5vw,82px);line-height:1.06}
 .orbit-intro>p{font-size:12px;margin-top:18px}
 .orbit-instruction{margin-top:16px;font-size:8px}
 .orbit-finale{display:none}
 .orbit-deck{position:relative;inset:auto;order:1;width:100%;height:460px;perspective:950px;transform-style:preserve-3d;cursor:grab;z-index:5;flex:none}
 .orbit-card{width:clamp(205px,53vw,287px);height:clamp(290px,73vw,375px);top:50%;left:50%;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .4s,box-shadow .3s}
 .orbit-card-caption{font-size:11px}

}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){

/* V5 refinements — compact story strip, cleaner hero stamp, scroll-driven mobile orbit */
.image-stamp{place-items:center}.stamp-ring{display:grid;place-items:center;inset:0;max-width:none;padding:0 19px;line-height:1.85;font-size:8px;text-align:center}.stamp-flower{display:none!important}

  .orbit-intro{position:absolute;left:50%;top:88px;translate:-50% 0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(100% - 38px,560px);margin:0;z-index:30;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}

  .orbit-footer span:first-child{display:block;width:100%}

}

/* FEMI ART V4 — focused mobile repair. Original Italiana / DM Sans / Cairo stacks retained. */
@media (max-width: 680px) {

  .featured, .collections { min-width: 0; }
  .shop-controls { min-width: 0; width: 100%; overflow: visible; }
  .filter-list {
    width: 100%; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0;

    padding: 2px 2px 10px;
    display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap;
    overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden;
    scrollbar-width: none;

  .shop-sort { width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; }

  .product-grid { width:100%; min-width:0; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .product-card { width:100%; min-width:0; }
  .product-photo { width:100%; min-width:0; border-radius:2px; }
  .product-photo img { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; object-fit:cover; }
  .product-details { min-width: 0; }
  .product-details > div { min-width: 0; }
  .product-name, .product-type, .product-pricing { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .product-name { font-size: clamp(11px,2.85vw,13px); line-height:1.65; }
  .product-tag { max-width:calc(100% - 12px); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
  .section-title, .orbit-intro h2, .story-strip p { overflow-wrap: normal; }
  .category-grid { min-width:0; }
  .category-card { min-width:0; }
  .category-title { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
  .story-strip { padding-block: 30px; }
  .story-strip-inner { min-width:0; }
  .story-strip-inner > span { flex-shrink: 0; }
}
@media (max-width: 380px) {

 .filter-pill { padding:9px 12px; }
}
